{i}Several hours later...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}几个小时后……{/i}

lines.en: scene nightsky

Imani and I decide to meet up in the urban district since it’s the closest place (within reasonable distance) that the two of us can go without fear of being caught by some of the other girls I am most likely sleeping with.
lines.zh: 我和 Imani 决定在市区碰面，因为那是在合理距离内、我们俩能去而不必担心被我大概正在睡的其他女孩撞见的最近的地方。

lines.en: She didn’t word it like that. That’s all me. In fact, I’m not sure she even knows that I {i}am{/i} sleeping with any of {s}our{/i} her students yet. And I doubt she’d like me nearly as much if she did.
lines.zh: 她可没这么说。这全是我自己加的。事实上，我不确定她是否已经知道我{i}确实{/i}在和{s}我们的{/i}她的学生上床。而且我怀疑她要是知道了，就不会这么喜欢我了。

lines.en: But, then again, I thought that with Chika too and we all know how things currently stand on that end.
lines.zh: 不过话又说回来，我对 Chika 也是这么想的，而我们都知道那边的局面现在是什么样。

lines.en: I think it’s best to probably keep Imani out of it, though. She’s cuter when she lives in whatever world allows her to believe I’m not even half as terrible as I am.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得最好还是别把 Imani 卷进来。她活在那个愿意相信我远没有实际那么糟糕的世界里时，更可爱。

lines.en: She’s bound to be pulled out of it one day, I’m sure. She’s friends with Osako, after all — and {i}she’s{/i} essentially known about Ayane and me for quite some time now without revealing as much to Wakana.
lines.zh: 她总有一天会被拉出来的，我确信。毕竟她和 Osako 是朋友——而{i}那位{/i}其实知道我和 Ayane 的事已经有一阵子了，却没向 Wakana 透露半点。

lines.en: The only question is how long Imani {i}and{/i} Wakana (if she’s still oblivious) can remain untainted by my misdeeds. Because I assume the red flags are piling up.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，Imani {i}和{/i} Wakana（如果她还蒙在鼓里的话）还能在我的劣迹下保持多久不被污染。因为我猜那些危险信号正在越堆越高。

lines.en: And we’re but one strong gust of wind away from that pile being strewn across their respective living places.
lines.zh: 而我们离那堆东西被一阵大风刮进她们各自的住处，只差一场强风。

lines.en: Will they still smile at me even then?
lines.zh: 到那时她们还会对我笑吗？

lines.en: Or will the looks on their faces be one I can not comprehend? Halfway between disappointed and...whatever else a normal person would think about the man (or child) I present myself as.
lines.zh: 还是说她们脸上的表情会变成我读不懂的那种？介于失望，和……一个正常人对我表现出来的这个男人（或者说孩子）会有的别的什么看法之间。

lines.en: I suppose that, if all else fails, and my adventurous assistant teacher simply {i}can’t{/i} let go of me even when she needs to, I can sever the ties with a knife I’ll call “truth.”
lines.zh: 我想，万一一切都完了，我那位爱冒险的助理教师就算该放手也{i}放不下{/i}我，我还可以用一把我称之为“真相”的刀斩断联系。

lines.en: It’s one I only taste the sting of when I can feel nothing else.
lines.zh: 那把刀，只有在别的什么都感觉不到的时候，我才尝得到它的刺痛。

lines.en: And oh, how I wish that were still the case.
lines.zh: 而我多希望现在还是那样啊。

lines.en: : Senpai! Over here!
lines.zh: : Senpai！这边！

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate1
: Perfect timing! I just got here myself.
lines.zh: : 来得正好！我自己也刚到。

lines.en: : I was worried I was going to be late. I had to wait for a different train since the first one was full of that huge group of Europeans who only show up every now and then.
lines.zh: : 我还怕自己会迟到。第一班车上全是那群隔三差五才出现一次的欧洲人，我只好等下一班。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate2
: The...huge group of {i}who?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那群……{i}什么{/i}人？

lines.en: : Europeans. Otoha hates them. Anyway, doesn’t matter now. It’s boner time.
lines.zh: : 欧洲人。Otoha 讨厌他们。算了，现在不重要了。是时候勃起了。

lines.en: : Boner time? But I thought it was Christmas date time.
lines.zh: : 勃起时间？我还以为现在是圣诞约会时间。

lines.en: : Those two things aren’t mutually exclusive. It can be boner date time.
lines.zh: : 这两件事并不冲突。可以是勃起约会时间。

lines.en: : It’s kind of a bad time for me right now. Biological functions and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 我现在不太方便。生理机能什么的。

lines.en: : That’s okay. You have a mouth.
lines.zh: : 没关系。你还有张嘴呢。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate3
: Damn, Senpai! You’re really coming out swingin’ today, huh?!
lines.zh: : 我去，Senpai！你今天一上来就火力全开啊？！

lines.en: : Sorry. I’ve never been good at “dates” so I normally just try and steer them to the primary objective as soon as I possibly can.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我从来不擅长“约会”，所以我通常会尽快把话题引向主要目标。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate4
: I didn’t invite you out because I was trying to get laid, Senpai. I like, genuinely just wanted to spend time with you and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我约你出来不是想上床，Senpai。我是、是真的就想和你待在一起什么的。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate5
: But if you {i}reeeeeally{/i} want me to suck your dick, I guess we can find an alleyway or something. I’m charging you the holiday rate, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是{i}真的真的真的{/i}想让我给你口，我想我们可以找条小巷子什么的。不过我要收你节日价。

lines.en: : No, it’s fine. We can just...{i}genuinely spend time together{/i} or whatever.
lines.zh: : 不，没事。我们就……{i}真心实意地待在一起{/i}什么的吧。

lines.en: : For {i}my{/i} sake? Nooooooo. It’s {i}clear{/i} you’re not going to calm down until {i}somebody{/i} sucks your dick. And since nobody {i}else{/i} is around, I guess it just {i}haaaas{/i} to be me.
lines.zh: : 为了{i}我{/i}？才不呢。很{i}明显{/i}，不{i}有人{/i}给你口你就消停不下来。既然{i}别的{/i}人都不在，我看就{i}只{/i}能是我了。

lines.en: : Imani, I’m fine. Really.
lines.zh: : Imani，我没事。真的。

lines.en: : No, no! It’s {i}clear{/i} you need this. I insist. But just so you know, I’m doing it for {i}you,{/i} not me.
lines.zh: : 不不！很{i}明显{/i}你需要。我来。不过先说清楚，我是为{i}你{/i}，不是为我自己。

lines.en: : Pass.
lines.zh: : 算了。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate6

: Question — are you saying “pass” for my sake? Or am I meant to interpret those three consecutive rejections as a sign that you no longer wish to be sexually involved with me {i}despite{/i} bringing up boner time?
lines.zh: : 问一句——你说“算了”是为了我？还是说，我该把这三连拒理解为你不想再和我上床了，{i}尽管{/i}是你自己先提的勃起时间？

lines.en: : Boner time is just my catchphrase at this point. And I do wish to be sexually involved with you. Just not right now since you clearly have other things planned.
lines.zh: : 勃起时间现在只是我的口头禅了。我确实想和你继续保持肉体关系。只是现在不行，你显然另有安排。

lines.en: : Cool. Because I also wish to continue being sexually involved with you. But I also respect your decision to not put your penis in my mouth right now.
lines.zh: : 酷。因为我也想继续和你保持肉体关系。不过我也尊重你现在不把鸡巴放进我嘴里的决定。

lines.en: : Rad.
lines.zh: : 酷毙了。

lines.en: : Even if you totally can if you {i}really{/i} want to.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是{i}真的{/i}想，完全可以。

lines.en: : Again, rad.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，酷毙了。

lines.en: : Like, if you were to just {i}go for it,{/i} I totally wouldn’t say no.
lines.zh: : 就是说，你要是{i}直接来{/i}，我绝对不会拒绝的。

lines.en: : How long are you going to keep this up for?
lines.zh: : 你要这样闹到什么时候？

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate7
: I don’t know. I am also very bad at dates. Including but not limited to asking people out on them, as I am sure you experienced earlier.
lines.zh: : 不知道。我也很不擅长约会。包括但不限于约人出来——这点你之前肯定领教过了。

lines.en: : We have so much in common.
lines.zh: : 我们真是有很多共同点。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate8
: Right! And you know what {i}else{/i} we have in common, Senpai?
lines.zh: : 对！那你知道我们{i}还{/i}有什么共同点吗，Senpai？

lines.en: : We’ve had at least one sexual encounter with a fruit?
lines.zh: : 我们都至少和一种水果发生过性关系？

lines.en: : No, we-
lines.zh: : 不，我们——

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate9
: Wait, {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 等等，{i}什么？{/i}

lines.en: : We’re both teachers?
lines.zh: : 我们都是老师？

lines.en: : Hell nah. You’re telling me about this fruit thing.
lines.zh: : 才不是。你得给我讲讲水果那件事。

lines.en: : Okay. But you have to go first.
lines.zh: : 好吧。不过你得先说。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate10
: I’ve never done that with a fruit!
lines.zh: : 我从来没和水果干过那事！

lines.en: : Really? But there are so many phallically shaped ones.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？可那么多水果都长得像鸡巴啊。

lines.en: : I know! Which is why I’ve {i}thought{/i} about it! But I’ve never actually {i}done{/i} it! Now, your turn! Which produce aisle do I need to keep you away from?!
lines.zh: : 我知道！所以我也{i}想{/i}过！但我真的没{i}做过{/i}！现在轮到你了！我得让你离哪个农产品货架远点？！

lines.en: : None. I just wanted to get you to admit something funny.
lines.zh: : 哪个都不用。我只是想让你承认点好笑的事。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate11
: You know, it’s good we got this out of the way now. Because if my idea for this date involved introducing you to my parents, I’m not sure they’d appreciate our dialogue.
lines.zh: : 知道吗，还好我们提前聊完了这些。因为要是这次约会的安排里包括带你去见我父母，我可不确定他们会欣赏我们的对话。

lines.en: : They better if you’re flying me all the way to Ghana to meet them.
lines.zh: : 你要专程带我飞去加纳见他们，他们最好欣赏。

lines.en: : Are you thinking what I’m thinking, Senpai?
lines.zh: : 你在想我想的事吗，Senpai？

lines.en: : Definitely not. I’m still on the fruit thing.
lines.zh: : 绝对不是。我还卡在水果那件事上。

lines.en: : Well, {i}I’m{/i} thinking we should start a comedy duo.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}我{/i}在想我们应该组个搞笑二人组。

lines.en: : That would never work, Imani.
lines.zh: : 那绝对行不通，Imani。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？

lines.en: : Racism.
lines.zh: : 种族歧视。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate12
: Damn. Foiled again.
lines.zh: : 靠。又泡汤了。

lines.en: : Also, I get stage fright.
lines.zh: : 还有，我有舞台恐惧症。

lines.en: : Tch, of course. I knew there had to be a reason you wouldn’t put your penis in my mouth.
lines.zh: : 啧，当然。我就知道你不把鸡巴放进我嘴里肯定另有原因。

lines.en: : Okay. I’m starting to think we should go somewhere else because I’m worried standing here and bantering like this will lead to us sucking up the rest of the time we have tonight.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我开始觉得我们该换个地方了，因为我怕站在这儿这么贫嘴，会把今晚剩下的时间都耗光。

lines.en: : I’m sure there’s some sort of fellatio-related joke to be made there, but now {i}I’m{/i} stuck on the fruit thing again too.
lines.zh: : 这肯定能接一个跟口交有关的梗，不过现在{i}我{/i}也又卡在水果那件事上了。

lines.en: scene black
: Come. We need to break free from our perpetual state of being hilarious.
lines.zh: : 走吧。我们得从这种持续搞笑的状态里挣脱出来。

lines.en: : Huh? Oh! Okay. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 哈？哦！好。行。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate13
: Do you have somewhere in mind? I don’t really come over here that often. I was okay with doing basically whatever tonight so long as we’re together.
lines.zh: : 你有想去的地方吗？我不怎么来这边。今晚干什么都行，只要能和你在一起。

lines.en: : You’re being way cuter than normal today and I’m going to need you to tone it down before I really {i}do{/i} squeeze the life out of you.
lines.zh: : 你今天比平时可爱太多了，在我真的把你{i}活活{/i}掐死之前，麻烦你收敛点。

lines.en: : Am I normally {i}not{/i} cute? Or is today just a really good day?
lines.zh: : 我平时{i}不{/i}可爱吗？还是说今天状态特别好？

lines.en: : Today is just a really good day, I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得是今天状态特别好。

lines.en: : It’s probably the hat. Or some kind of Christmas miracle. But the second you start singing, I’m outta here. There are lines that even I must draw, Senpai.
lines.zh: : 大概是帽子的功劳。或者是某种圣诞奇迹。不过你一开口唱歌我立马就走。有些底线连我都得守，Senpai。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate14
: Senpai?
lines.zh: : Senpai？

lines.en: : I looked up what that thing you said meant.
lines.zh: : 你之前说的那句话，我查过是什么意思了。

lines.en: : Hm?
: I’ve said a lot of things. What are you talking about, exactly?
lines.zh: : 我说过的话可多了。你具体指哪句？

lines.en: : The Twi thing. Medɔ wo.
lines.zh: : 那句契维语。Medɔ wo。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate15
: Eh?! Ah!? Huh?! What!? When?! Why?!
lines.zh: : 诶？！啊！？哈？！什么！？什么时候？！为什么？！

lines.en: : After that beach trip. It sounded nice, so I wanted to know what it meant.
lines.zh: : 那次海边之旅之后。听起来很好听，所以我想知道是什么意思。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate16
: Oooooooooh God. Oh no. Forget it. Forget I said that. Forget what it means. Forget everything ever and don’t look at me for at least the next...ten years? Twenty years? Sound good? Good.
lines.zh: : 噢噢噢噢噢噢天啊。完了。当我没说。忘了我说过那句话。忘了它的意思。把一切都忘了，而且接下来至少……十年？二十年？别看我。行吗？行。

lines.en: : I thought you {i}wanted{/i} me to look up what it meant?
lines.zh: : 我以为你{i}想{/i}让我查它的意思呢？

lines.en: : Not like {i}this!{/i}
lines.zh: : 可不是{i}这种查法！{/i}

lines.en: : Is it true, Imani?
lines.zh: : 那是真的吗，Imani？

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate17
: I didn’t think you’d {i}actually{/i} look it up! I was just saying things! I do that sometimes!
lines.zh: : 我没想到你{i}真的{/i}会去查！我就是随口说说！我有时候就这样！

lines.en: : So it’s {i}not{/i} true then?
lines.zh: : 所以{i}不是{/i}真的咯？

lines.en: : No! Of course not!
lines.zh: : 不是！当然不是！

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate18
: I was just...you know...
lines.zh: : 我只是……你知道的……

lines.en: : I get...caught up in the mood sometimes and...and {i}words{/i} happen.
lines.zh: : 我有时候会……陷进气氛里，然后……然后就冒出一些{i}话{/i}来。

lines.en: : But they’re just words, Senpai. You know {i}words.{/i} You’re a...{i}writer{/i} guy. Surely {i}you{/i} can understand, like...context and........stuff.
lines.zh: : 可那只是些话而已，Senpai。你懂{i}话{/i}的。你是个……{i}写作{/i}的人。{i}你{/i}肯定能理解，比如……语境之类的…………东西。

lines.en: : So if I told you I love you, you wouldn’t be able to say it back?
lines.zh: : 那如果我对你说我爱你，你也说不出来？

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate19
: Huh?
: What would you do?
lines.zh: : 你会怎么做？

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate20
: It’s not nice to mess with girls like this, Senpai. I’m already embarrassed enough.
lines.zh: : 这样捉弄女孩子可不厚道，Senpai。我已经够难为情了。

lines.en: scene black
I thought about saying it.
lines.zh: 我想过要说出口。

lines.en: Really, I did.
lines.zh: 真的想过。

lines.en: There’s just no language I could do it in that she wouldn’t understand.
lines.zh: 只是没有任何一种语言，能让我说出来而不被她听懂。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate21
It took Imani roughly twenty minutes to calm down, and thirty to be able to look me in the eyes again.
lines.zh: Imani 花了大约二十分钟才平静下来，又花了三十分钟才敢重新直视我的眼睛。

lines.en: I try not to spend too much time thinking about exactly what she meant by those words as, despite not knowing much about love, even I can understand that it has different levels.
lines.zh: 我尽量不去花太多时间琢磨她那句话到底是什么意思——虽然我不太懂爱，但连我也明白爱是分层次的。

lines.en: And I think in some regard, she really {i}does{/i} love me. And in that regard, {i}I{/i} probably love her too. But I probably love Wakana as well if we’re going to water down the word like that.
lines.zh: 我想在某种意义上，她真的{i}爱{/i}我。而在那个意义上，{i}我{/i}大概也爱她。不过要是把这个词稀释到那种程度，我大概也爱 Wakana。

lines.en: What I don’t understand is when it’s okay to say it. When you’re {i}allowed{/i} to love someone. And if I used those words on people like them, what would it mean for girls like Ayane?
lines.zh: 我不明白的是，什么时候才可以说出口。什么时候你被{i}允许{/i}去爱一个人。还有，如果我把这些话用在她们这样的人身上，那对 Ayane 那样的女孩又意味着什么？

lines.en: I guess it doesn’t matter now. She’s over it, so I should be too.
lines.zh: 我想现在也不重要了。她已经过去了，我也该过去。

lines.en: And I should focus on making this night memorable for {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: 我该把心思放在让{i}她{/i}记住这个夜晚上。

lines.en: I can’t do that if I’m only thinking about myself.
lines.zh: 要是我只想着自己，就做不到。

lines.en: : This is a nice place, Senpai. Festive. And with enough alcohol, I might even be able to forget how insanely embarrassed I am to look you in the eyes again.
lines.zh: : 这地方不错，Senpai。很有节日气氛。而且喝够了酒，我说不定还能忘了自己有多不好意思直视你的眼睛。

lines.en: : You were able to look me in the eyes without any trouble at all the night I ate you out for several hours straight.
lines.zh: : 我连着舔了你几个小时那晚，你可是眼睛都不眨地看着我的。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate22
: Because {i}that{/i} was less embarrassing. There’s no shame to be had when it comes to sex. {i}Feelings,{/i} though? That’s the stuff that gets you.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}那个{/i}没那么丢人。性这件事没什么好羞耻的。可{i}感情{/i}呢？那才要命。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’ve ever related to you as much as I do right now, Imani.
lines.zh: : 我从没像此刻这样和你有共鸣，Imani。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate23
: We have so much in common, remember? We both haven’t had sex with any fruit yet.
lines.zh: : 我们有很多共同点，记得吗？我们都还没跟水果上过床呢。

lines.en: : “Yet” implies the possibility that it may still happen.
lines.zh: : “还没”意味着它仍有可能发生。

lines.en: : Let’s hope neither one of us ever reaches that level of loneliness, okay?
lines.zh: : 但愿我们俩都别孤独到那个地步，好吗？

lines.en: : Imani, I have something to confess.
lines.zh: : Imani，我有一件事要坦白。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate24
: I knew it! You {i}have!{/i} Haven’t you?!
lines.zh: : 我就知道！你{i}干过{/i}！对不对？！

lines.en: : It was an accident. Probably.
lines.zh: : 那是意外。大概吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, sure. And Timothee Chalamet just tripped and fell into that peach in Call Me By Your Name. I need details. Now.
lines.zh: : 是啊，当然。就像 Timothee Chalamet 在《请以你的名字呼唤我》里是不小心绊了一跤摔进那只桃子里的。我要细节。现在就要。

lines.en: : I...don’t even know how to provide them. I just know that I have several vague memories of using a watermelon to-
lines.zh: : 我……都不知道从哪儿说起。我只知道自己有几段模糊的记忆，关于用一颗西瓜来——

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate25
: Wait, a {i}watermelon?{/i} Aren’t they a little, like...huge? And hard? And...watery?
lines.zh: : 等等，{i}西瓜{/i}？它们不是有点……很大吗？还很硬？还……很多水？

lines.en: : You are asking the wrong person.
lines.zh: : 你问错人了。

lines.en: : Is...Is there a {i}right{/i} person to ask?
lines.zh: : 是……有什么{i}对{/i}的人可以问吗？

lines.en: : Did...someone {i}make{/i} you fuck a watermelon, Senpai?
lines.zh: : 是……有人{i}逼{/i}你和西瓜做爱吗，Senpai？

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate26
: You know what? Let’s just talk about Christmas instead. We’ve both embarrassed ourselves enough for tonight.
lines.zh: : 这样吧。我们还是聊圣诞节吧。今晚我们俩都丢够人了。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate27
: I may have practiced sucking dick with a zucchini once.
lines.zh: : 我可能用一根西葫芦练过一次口交。

lines.en: I knew it.
lines.zh: 我就知道。

lines.en: : Who are we, Imani?
lines.zh: : 我们算什么啊，Imani？

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate28
: A couple of weirdos apparently. But it’s that sorta thing that makes us fun, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 显然是两个怪胎。不过正是这种事让我们有趣，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Fun is certainly {i}one{/i} word for it.
lines.zh: : 有趣当然是{i}其中{/i}一种说法。

lines.en: : What- are you {i}not{/i} having fun tonight?
lines.zh: : 什么——你今晚{i}不{/i}开心吗？

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate29
: Walking around...making fun of each other...taking in all the lights...the decorations...
lines.zh: : 到处走走……互相吐槽……看着那些灯……那些装饰……

lines.en: : It’s exactly what I wanted out of a Christmas date. And there’s no one I’d rather be here with than you, Senpai.
lines.zh: : 这正是我想从圣诞约会里得到的。而且除了你，我不想和任何人一起待在这儿，Senpai。

lines.en: : I’m really glad you said yes.
lines.zh: : 真高兴你答应了。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate30
: You know, Christmas actually used to be a pretty huge part of my life. Have I ever told you that?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，圣诞节以前在我的人生里其实占很大的比重。我跟你说过吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think so. But I can feel a flashback coming on, so I’m sure that means you’re going to now.
lines.zh: : 应该没有。不过我感觉一段回忆杀要来了，所以你肯定是要说了。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate31
: {i}Well, I told you my father was a pastor right?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，我跟你说过我父亲是牧师吧？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That sounds familiar, so probably.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}听着耳熟，应该是说过。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well, I don’t know how much you know about all that religious mumbo-jumbo, and I’m sure you don’t care either, but my dad looooved Christmas.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，我不知道你对那些宗教的玩意儿了解多少，估计你也不在乎，但我爸超——爱圣诞节的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And, as you know, I loved my dad. Which meant that I tried to make him happy any way I could.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而且你也知道，我爱我爸。所以我会想尽办法让他高兴。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And sometimes, that meant sitting around and listening to him read from the Book of Luke even when all of my brothers and sisters had gotten too old or too bored to bother with that.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}有时候，这就意味着坐着听他念《路加福音》——哪怕我的兄弟姐妹们都已经长大或者腻烦到懒得陪他了。{/i}

lines.en: : When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has told us about.”
lines.zh: 众天使离开他们升天去了，牧羊的人彼此说：“我们往伯利恒去，看看主所指示我们所成就的事。”

lines.en: : So they hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and the baby, who was lying in the manger.
lines.zh: 他们急忙去了，就寻见马利亚和约瑟，又有那婴孩卧在马槽里。

lines.en: : When they had seen him, they spread the word concerning what had been told them about this child, and all who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds said to them.
lines.zh: 既已看见，就把天使论这孩子的话传开了；凡听见的，都诧异牧羊之人对他们所说的话。

lines.en: : But Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart.
lines.zh: 马利亚却把这一切的事存在心里，反复思想。

lines.en: : The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things they had heard and seen, which were just as they had been told.
lines.zh: 牧羊的人回去了，因所听见所看见的一切事，正如天使向他们所说的，就归荣耀于神、赞美他。

lines.en: : On the eighth day, when it was time to circumcise the child, he was named Jesus, the name the angel had given him before he was conceived.
lines.zh: 满了八天，就给孩子行割礼，给他起名叫耶稣；这就是没有成胎以前，天使所起的名。

lines.en: : Dad, I have a question.
lines.zh: : 爸爸，我有个问题。

lines.en: : And I have an answer.
lines.zh: : 而我有个答案。

lines.en: : Why does Jesus have so many names?
lines.zh: : 为什么耶稣有这么多名字？

lines.en: : Joshua. Jesus. Yeshua. Son of Man...You’re always referring to him differently. But if he was actually named Jesus-
lines.zh: : Joshua、Jesus、Yeshua、人子……你每次提到他用的都不一样。可如果他真的叫 Jesus-

lines.en: : They are {i}all{/i} his names, Imani.
lines.zh: : 这些{i}全{/i}都是他的名字，Imani。

lines.en: : The Bible has been adapted more times than one can count. And depending on who is adapting or translating the text, different names are used.
lines.zh: : 《圣经》被改编的次数多得数不清。而根据改编或翻译的人不同，使用的名字也不一样。

lines.en: : The name “Yehoshua” or “Yeshua” is mostly used in Hebrew texts. And before we had “Jesus,” we had “Iesus.”
lines.zh: : “Yehoshua”或者“Yeshua”主要用于希伯来文本。而在我们有“Jesus”之前，还有“Iesus”。

lines.en: : But it does not matter how his name is spelled, my daughter. What matters is-
lines.zh: : 但他的名字怎么拼写并不重要，我的女儿。重要的是-

lines.en: : What he stands for and the lessons he can teach us. I know, Dad. I was just confused, that’s all.
lines.zh: : 他所代表的东西，以及他能教给我们的道理。我知道，爸爸。我只是有点搞混了，就这样。

lines.en: : Then how about we take a break for today? You can come with me to the market and help me deliver the banku your mother cooked for-
lines.zh: : 那我们今天就休息一下吧？你可以跟我去市场，帮我把你妈妈做的 banku 送去给-

lines.en: : I have one more question.
lines.zh: : 我还有一个问题。

lines.en: : Of course. What is it?
lines.zh: : 当然。是什么？

lines.en: : What does it mean to “circumcise” a child?
lines.zh: : 给孩子“行割礼”是什么意思？

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate32
: And that was the first and last time I ever talked to my dad about penises. The end.
lines.zh: : 那就是我第一次也是最后一次和爸爸聊鸡巴。讲完了。

lines.en: : That story took a weird turn near the end.
lines.zh: : 这故事到后面走向有点怪。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate33
: It did. But the point is this-
lines.zh: : 确实。不过重点是-

lines.en: : This holiday, to me, has always been about spending time with the people I care about.
lines.zh: : 对我来说，这个节日一直都是和我关心的人待在一起。

lines.en: : Not just this year either. The last couple — getting to spend it with you and the girls...it’s been amazing. And I’m truly grateful to have finally found somewhere it feels like I belong.
lines.zh: : 也不只是今年。过去这几年——能和你还有女孩们一起过……真的很棒。我也真心感激自己终于找到了一个让我有归属感的地方。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate34
: But what’s it like for you, Senpai? Do {i}you{/i} have anything you always think about when the holidays roll around? Or are you too Japanese for that?
lines.zh: : 那你呢，Senpai？节日一到，{i}你{/i}有什么一定会想到的事吗？还是说你太日本了，没有这种东西？

lines.en: : Christmas is getting pretty popular here, if you haven’t already noticed.
lines.zh: : 圣诞节在这儿越来越流行了，你应该注意到了吧。

lines.en: : I have. But what does that mean for {i}you?{/i}
lines.zh: : 注意到了。可那对{i}你{/i}来说意味着什么？

lines.en: : Lately...just Christmas parties.
lines.zh: : 最近……就是圣诞派对吧。

lines.en: : Seeing everyone together. Getting roped into both joyous {i}and{/i} tragic events one after the other. Letting some people down. Lifting some others up.
lines.zh: : 看着大家聚在一起。被卷进一件接一件或喜{i}或{/i}悲的事里。让一些人失望。又把另一些人托起来。

lines.en: : Just another day then?
lines.zh: : 那也就是普普通通的一天咯？

lines.en: : Pretty much...yeah.
lines.zh: : 差不多……嗯。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate35
: I did...mean it, you know.
lines.zh: : 我那句话……是认真的，你知道的。

lines.en: : That thing I said.
lines.zh: : 我说的那件事。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate36
: Like...it might not be {i}love-{/i}love yet.
lines.zh: : 就是……可能还不是那种{i}爱-{/i}爱。

lines.en: : And...I know you get weird when I talk about this, so I’ll try and keep it brief and...painless, but...
lines.zh: : 而且……我知道我一说这个你就会别扭，所以我尽量简短一点、……让你不那么难受，不过……

lines.en: : I’d be really happy if...
lines.zh: : 我会很开心，如果……

lines.en: : If the rest of my Christmases were just like this one.
lines.zh: : 如果往后的圣诞节都像今天这样。

lines.en: : Well, the night’s not over yet.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不过今晚还没结束呢。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate37
: I knew you’d come around. But if anybody sees me going down on you, this was {i}your{/i} idea, not mine.
lines.zh: : 我就知道你会想通的。不过要是有人看见我给你口，那是{i}你{/i}的主意，不是我的。

lines.en: : Imani, no. I meant there’s some other sappy, quintessential place the two of us need to go if you {i}really{/i} want to call this a Christmas date.
lines.zh: : Imani，不是。我是说，如果你{i}真的{/i}想把这称为圣诞约会，那我们俩还得去另一个老套又经典的地方。

lines.en: scene imanixmasdate38
: KFC?
lines.zh: : KFC？

lines.en: $ christmasimani1 = True
$ imani_love += 1
jump christmasimani2
